messages:
Noah (partnerships): kicking off a quick thread for SentinelLock (HSM vendor) + VaultBridge (SI) joint marketplace tile + integration checklist. target: staging tile in ~10 days. scope: SAML/SSO metadata exchange, SCIM provisioning delta, KMS wrap/unwrap compatibility, attestation check, and a short test harness for onboarding.
Sofia (SentinelLock): excited to partner. we expose PKCS#11 and a /v1/keys/wrap REST endpoint (OAuth2 bearer). we have Common Criteria and attestation docs ready.
Gabe (VaultBridge): we'll run a pilot with 4 customers. need an SE onboarding script, SCIM mapping recommendations, and a flow for exchanging SAML metadata.
Renee (security): checklist: 1) attestation chain verification, 2) wrap/unwrap test vectors, 3) signed key import flow, 4) SAML certificate/fingerprint exchange, 5) SCIM incremental sync (delta). I can draft this.
Maya (solutions-eng): SCIM suggestion: map emails[0].value -> userName, name.formatted -> displayName, roles -> groups. prefer using the since param for delta sync. example snippet:```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "sam.dev@example.com",
  "name": {"formatted": "Sam Dev"},
  "emails": [{"value": "sam.dev@example.com"}],
  "groups": ["platform-team"]
}```
Noah (partnerships): thanks Maya 1 1 include that in the partner playbook.
Renee (security): rotation + fallback: HSM keys must support in-place rotation. if attestation or connectivity fails, Redwood should fall back to a wrapped KMS key under customer control. will include policy language.
Sofia (SentinelLock): we support rotation via admin API. sample wrap request:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.sentinellock.example.com/v1/keys/wrap -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"key_id":"sl-0001","plaintext":"..."}'
```
Priest (legal): embargo: no public announcement before 2024-09-10 18:00 PT. need a co-marketing addendum + logo release forms. also require approval flow: partner -> Redwood partnerships -> Redwood legal -> partner signoff. I'll prepare templates.
Oliver (product): marketplace asks: short description, 3 bullets, screenshots, architecture diagram, and entitlements list for gating. can we do a staged canary: week1 limited rollout to pilot accounts, week2 open?
Gabe (VaultBridge): yes please gate by account tag. also want a small "early access" checkbox on sign-up.
Maya (solutions-eng): test harness plan: SCIM provisioning, SSO SAML login (SP-initiated), wrap/unwrap roundtrip using provided vectors, and attestation verification. I'll make a repo and CI job.
ci-bot: Repo created: partners/sentinellock-vaultbridge-integration - initial CI jobs: scim,saml,wrap-tests.
Noah (partnerships): action items: @Renee security checklist by Thu EOD; @Priest legal addendum + logo forms by Mon; @Maya scaffold test repo + invite partners; @Sofia send attestation + certs; @Oliver create marketplace placeholder and enable gating.
Sofia (SentinelLock): sending certs and attestation bundle to vault link now.
Renee (security): will add wrap/unwrap test vectors and a mock attestation verifier to the repo.
Priest (legal): one quick Q 1 any customer quotes in the joint blurb? will need explicit written permission.
Gabe (VaultBridge): we'll surface any pilot customer approvals early.
Noah (partnerships): thanks all 1 next sync Thu 9:30am PT. I'll post calendar and short agenda. :spiral_calendar_pad:
